name: Rebbel
description: Rebbel is an AI marketing department for small businesses. Connect a brand — from a website URL, or by linking a social account directly — and Rebbel drafts a brand guide, marketing strategy, and full campaigns: copy, images, and video, in your brand's voice. Prefer to just post? Write your own copy and publish it as-is, no brand setup required. Every asset, every scheduled post, and every dollar of AI generation cost goes through human approval first; nothing publishes without you saying yes. Free to start: no credit card, a monthly generation allowance to try a full campaign end to end. Built for small business owners who don't have a marketing department, not agencies replacing one.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rebbel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rebbel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.rebbel.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rebbel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rebbel lists 26 MCP tools, including approve_brand_guide, approve_post, approve_strategy, archive_brand, archive_campaign, create_adhoc_post, create_brand, create_post, disconnect_connection, draft_first_post, generate_brand_guide, and generate_campaign.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rebbel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rebbel in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Rebbel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rebbel is developed by Rebbel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
